subject: Constrain correlations between items to be negative

messages.author: 7636027d6c15836f
messages.subject: Constrain correlations between items to be negative
parts:
I am trying to create a CFA model in lavaan and I do not know how to constrain some parameters

I need for instance the covariance between some observed items to be negative whilst in other cases I need it to be positive

In addition I need to constrain error for items to be the sum of ψ's (e.g. Ψ 2 7 + Ψ 2 8)

As I understand it a CFA can be created in that way

model<-' η2=ψ4 5 + ψ5 6 + ψ7 8 + ψ8 9
               η3=ψ4 6 + ψ7 8 + ψ7 8 + ψ7 8

               η2~~1*η2
               η3~~1*η3

# how I define constraints for negative covariances between items?
# how I define uniqueness so that is equal to sum of 2 utility uniqunesses
'

messages.author: 0325c6a976085eab
messages.subject: Re: Constrain correlations between items to be negative
parts:
This is straightforward to do, but why do you need it to be negative (or positive). The value of the covariance comes from the data. 

Here's how to do it:

y_78 ~~ c1 * y_89 # sets up the covariance and labels it
# constraints
c1 < 0

Note that this also makes your df weird, and so you might not get a chi-square p-value.

Jeremy
